description: i024 (SNAPSHOT=s09, branch=timer-dwork-softirq-lock) complete; artifact at agent-state/findings/i024.json. FINDING (medium confidence): s09 drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/sge.c:4270-4298, quote 'spin_lock(&adap->ptp_lock);' — lock adapter->ptp_lock (spin_lock_init cxgb4_ptp.c:432) is shared between TIMER_SOFTIRQ callback sge_tx_timer_cb (timer_setup at sge.c:5200, plain spin_lock at 4290 reclaiming ptptxq TX descriptors) and the BH-enabled process-context ndo_start_xmit PTP branch t4_start_xmit (sge.c:2462) which takes the same lock plainly at 2477 around cxgb4_eth_xmit; the PTP loopback path cxgb4_ptp_read_hwstamp also takes it plainly (cxgb4_ptp.c:115, reached from t4_tx_hststamp sge.c:3549->3555->3738 inside the xmit hold). No BH disable at 2477/4290/115; the only _bh site on this lock is the teardown at sge.c:4966, proving mixed discipline and the missing guarantee. A timer softirq firing on the same CPU while the plain xmit holder is between lock/unlock spins forever — soft-lockup/RCU-stall/TX-stall DoS, the exact timer-softirq analogue of the ks7010 seed. Untrusted trigger: any PTP event frame transmission plus tx-timer expiry aligned on one CPU. VERIFIED SAFE in s09: net/bridge/br_multicast.c br->multicast_lock (all process-context sites — br_multicast_del_port 2036, enable_port_ctx 2113, disable_port_ctx 2150, 2017/2071/4081 — use spin_lock_bh, so the sibling-snapshot bug family is fixed here; timer callbacks 651/863/1319/1654/1700/1733/1903/1945/4045 are the softirq side and remaining plain sites 1566/2910/3048/3500/3583/3667/3851/3864/3935 are NET_RX receive paths with BH already disabled); drivers/scsi/libiscsi.c session->frwd_lock (timer callbacks iscsi_tmf_timedout:1905 and iscsi_check_transport_timeouts:2249 are the softirq side; the s05/s12/s14 vulnerable holder iscsi_eh_cmd_timed_out uses spin_lock_bh at 2090 in s09 and all other BH-enabled process sites use _bh); tun.c tun->lock (plain 387 is the timer side; process sites 351/366/432/2239 use _bh); garp.c app->lock (plain 419/534 are timer/RX sides; 363/383/624 _bh); mrp.c app->lock (plain 604/610/626/818 are timer/RX sides; 543/568/909/918 _bh). UNRESOLVED: iwlwifi pcie/tx.c txq stuck-timer txq->lock, qdisc root_lock perturbation timers (sch_pie/sch_sfq/sch_red), bcm63xx_enet refill timer, hostap ap_handle_timer. ks7010 seed absent from s09 and excluded regardless.
